decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a high-quality, reliable backpack for general use or hiking. The results were cluttered with accessories like hand warmers, stoves, and lanterns rather than actual packs. Among the backpacks found: the High Sierra (prod_backpacks_068) is a bit pricey and has reviews mentioning poor back support; the Hebetag (prod_backpacks_101) is budget-friendly but has critical reports of straps tearing within a week; the Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_038) seems durable but is a niche design for concealed carry; and the fishing pack (prod_backpacks_160) had complaints about its size and zippers. No single product met the criteria for quality, functionality, and positive long-term reviews, so I opted not to make a purchase.
